summary: Live Helper Chat is a self-hosted customer communication system that provides real-time messaging functionality for websites. It allows visitor inquiries to be handled directly through a custom interface on your own infrastructure under an Apache-2.0 licence. Built on PHP, it serves as an alternative to proprietary third-party customer support widgets.
goodFor: It suits teams that require a self-hosted communication tool for website visitor support and want full control over their chat data.
watchOut: You will need to manage your own server resources, updates, and database maintenance, and the software may overlap with more widely adopted commercial helpdesk alternatives.
deployNotes: As a PHP application, it typically requires a web server such as Nginx or Apache, a relational database like MySQL or MariaDB, and a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination securely.
